items: When a 30-minute bar closes and slow %K crosses below %D with the previous %K above 80 (%K 14, smoothing 3, %D 3, 20 / 80), sell short at the open of the next 15-minute bar; a signal within 16 fifteen-minute bars after the previous one is skipped

Close at the open of the 16th fifteen-minute bar after entry (4 trading hours; a break or weekend inside the hold is held through; the report's holding count includes the entry and the exit bar and shows 17); no stop loss, no take profit
